en: The postcard features a winter scene with snow covering the ground and trees without leaves. In the background, there is a mosque with a prominent minaret, and a group of people are seen walking or skating on a frozen body of water. There is a wooden fence in the foreground and a round tower partially visible behind the trees, suggesting historical architecture. The image is in sepia or black-and-white, giving it a vintage appearance.
